title: Glass Department Note: Re-Reserving Glass for Orders Released From Hold — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Note.** For Factory Production Orders released from a customer hold, glass re-reservation adds business days as well:

- an order carrying a **glass-supplier delay notice** adds **2 business days**;
- an order without one whose **glass received checkpoint** is on record adds **1 business day**;
- any other order adds nothing.

The days added are counted in business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) starting the day after the ship date first set at release, and the date reached is the requoted ship date.

## Records read

Both items are entries on the order's milestone records: a delay notice with cause glass supplier, and a checkpoint of the kind glass received.

## Truth table

| Glass-supplier delay notice on the order | Glass received checkpoint on record | Business days added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | yes | 1 |
| no | no | none |

## Hypothetical case

An order with two glass-supplier delay notices and a glass received checkpoint adds 2 business days; the number of notices does not raise the figure.
